title: AGO - Problem closed resolve ServiceNow (Connection) and PagerDuty
description: When Dynatrace Problem closes, find ServiceNow INC by correlation_id via Connection, resolve it, and resolve PagerDuty with the same dedup_key.

eventTrigger.filterQuery: event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND (event.status == "CLOSED" OR event.status_transition == "RESOLVED" OR event.status_transition == "CLOSED")

prepare-close-ids.name: prepare-close-ids
prepare-close-ids.description: Build problemId and dedupKey from closed Problem event.

search-snow-incident.name: search-snow-incident
search-snow-incident.description: Find INC by correlation_id using ServiceNow Connection.

resolve-snow-incident.name: resolve-snow-incident
resolve-snow-incident.description: Resolve found ServiceNow INC via Connection.
